input.prompt: A colored-pencil drawing on cream paper comes to life, still a hand-drawn pencil drawing in every frame: the same fine pencil lines, the same paper texture and soft hatching as the first frame, never a photo, never 3D. The young woman sings, in English, the words from the reference audio, 'I just ask myself what it is', her lips shaping each syllable in time with the voice: mouth opening on 'I', a short 'j' on 'just', lips closing on the 'm' of 'myself', opening on 'what' and 'is'. She sings it to the giant gray rubber-eraser creature on the right, gently, holding the yellow pencil with the blue cap and rainbow tip up in her raised hand; the pencil stays the same. The Eraser listens: a slow blink, its mouth stays still and slightly open. Through all of it she stays the same person as in the first frame: the same large head, heart-shaped face with a soft chin, tall forehead with the high centre-parted hairline and full hair volume above it, the two slightly different eyebrows, the same big dark-brown eyes, natural matte lips. Do not redraw, beautify, slim, age or restyle her face; no makeup. Her long black hair stays loose and down. Static locked-off camera, no zoom, no push-in, framing exactly as in the first frame. No captions, no subtitles, no new text, no new objects.
